description: Candidate action-family registry for the SF1 Scalable Frontier Miner. Each family is an eval arm / proposal; SF1 never auto-flips a production flag. 'production_promoted' reflects the RC1 release as of commit f3b3100. Status proposals from SF1 land in notes only.

gate_types.namespace_gated_battery: cheap battery tactic fired only inside a narrow syntactic/namespace gate (strong-base-policy surfaces)
gate_types.symbolic_structural_action: constructor/ext/induction action for weak-base-policy structural surfaces
gate_types.learned_selector: TF-IDF/logreg or similar learned action chooser (kept off the hot path)

families.notes: NS9 base wrapper / genome. The floor every SF1 delta is measured against; also exposed as the 'ns9' eval arm. Do not modify.

RC1 = NS9 base + WX3 Multiset induction oracle + MX2 narrow Set.Finite aesop. +15 wins beyond NS9, 0 regressions, 0 off-gate, floors preserved. SF1 control arm. Config: project/evolve/experiments/rc1/rc1_production_wrapper.json. Do not modify.

Multiset induction_on action (MULTISET_INDUCTION_SIMP[Multiset,simp_all]). +12 Multiset wins inside RC1; the canonical weak-base-policy structural surface. 20 clean single-shot symbolic labels at promotion.
Narrow Set.Finite/toFinset-gated aesop fallback (NS19 deep-copy pattern). +3 Set.Finite wins inside RC1, 0 non-Set aesop. Strict narrow gate adopted over broad Set. gate.

TF-IDF + logreg symbolic-action predictor over proof state (46 labels at AX4). GREEN/promotion-eligible as a learner but the deterministic WX3 oracle still dominates a single additive Multiset action. Kept off the hot path.
families.reason: Beats raw but not the deterministic oracle on mined surfaces; label-limited. MINE_MORE: reach a live-Lean mine of stronger/multi-action labels and beat the oracle before live integration (criterion 1 + 6).

families.notes: Depth-2 symbolic sequence mode (commit 63c2b78). seq-only-vs-oracle=3 but seq-only-vs-full-wrapper=0: the existing NS9/WX3 best-first search already explores ~9 follow-ups per advanced symbolic state, so a fixed-battery sequence mode is subsumed. 0 regr, 0 off-gate.
families.reason: No search gain beyond the existing best-first wrapper (subsumed). The open lever is selectivity (an AX5 sequence-label learner), which needs a live-Lean mine to >=40 labels first.

families.notes: Broad 'Set.' aesop gate. Adds NO wins beyond the narrow Set.Finite/toFinset gate but overfires (aesop 12x on negative control, 0 closes).
families.reason: Fails promotion criterion 3 (off-gate emissions) and criterion 4 (strict syntactic gate) at equal wins. Superseded by mx2_set_finite_tofinset_aesop.

families.notes: Set/Finset symbolic ext/cases mine (SET_EXT_SIMP / FINSET_EXT_SIMP / FINSET_CASES_SIMP), commit 8ec8c99. 2 new Set-ext wins but both aesop-over-attributed -> 0 clean symbolic labels; Finset ext/cases fired 140x and closed 0 (NS21 aesop saturation).
families.reason: Fails criterion 5 (minimal-sufficient attribution): wins are over-attributed to aesop. Symbolic actions do not pay on strong-base-policy Set/Finset surfaces; that headroom belongs to the cheap namespace-gated battery (MX2).

notes: Status proposals emitted by sf1_promotion_report.py are advisory and written to the SF1 report, not back into this file automatically.
production_promoted reflects the RC1 release (commit f3b3100); SF1 must never change it without a full RC2 re-freeze.
